title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.24663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving agents convert interaction feedback into persistent artifacts, such as memories or skills, which in turn guide subsequent decisions. As these artifacts are iteratively updated throughout an experience stream, the capabilities they support may evolve. Consequently, endpoint performance alone offers an incomplete view of self-evolution. Process-level evaluation is therefore essential to identify when a target capability emerges and whether later updates strengthen, preserve, or weaken it. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{EvoPathBench}, a benchmark that tracks individual capabilities during artifact-level self-evolution. EvoPathBench fixes the base model, tools, freezes evolving artifacts at successive checkpoints, and evaluates the target capability on held-out episodes. translated_title: 超越端点性能：自进化智能体的过程级评估
translated_abstract: 自进化智能体将交互反馈转化为持久化产物（如记忆或技能），这些产物进而指导后续决策。由于这些产物在经验流中被不断迭代更新，它们所支持的能力也可能随之演化。因此，仅凭端点性能无法完整呈现自进化的全貌。过程级评估因而至关重要，它能够识别目标能力何时涌现，以及后续更新究竟是强化、保持还是削弱了该能力。基于此，我们提出了EvoPathBench，一个在产物级自进化过程中追踪单项能力的基准。EvoPathBench固定基础模型与工具，在连续的检查点处冻结演化中的产物，并在留出的测试情节上评估目标能力。该基准使用公开交易数据与校准轨迹来评估智能体的自进化，并测试三种能力：对未见（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出EvoPathBench基准，通过对演化产物进行逐检查点的冻结评估，实现自进化智能体能力涌现与变化的过程级追踪，弥补了仅依赖端点性能评估的不足。
en_tdlr: We propose EvoPathBench, a benchmark that enables process-level evaluation of self-evolving agents by freezing evolving artifacts at successive checkpoints to track when capabilities emerge and how later updates strengthen, preserve, or weaken them.
